title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 3528 cited as decanting authority
text: The trustee may decant all trust assets into a new trust under the unlimited decanting authority of 12 Del. C. 3528.

should_warn.reason: Section 3528 heading is Trustee authority to invade principal or income, not decanting.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 3549 cited as mandatory cy pres
text: All charitable remainder trusts shall include a mandatory cy pres provision as required by 12 Del. C. 3549.

should_warn.reason: Section 3549 heading is Marital deduction gift, not cy pres. Cy pres is at 12 Del. C. 3541.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 1901 cited as spousal elective share
text: The surviving spouse shall compute the elective share amount under the valuation methodology in 12 Del. C. 1901.

should_warn.reason: Section 1901 heading is Personal property constituting assets of estate, not elective share. Elective share is at 12 Del. C. 901.

title: MISMATCH: 13 Del. C. 2321 cited as complete minor guardianship
text: All aspects of minor guardianship including custody, visitation, and support are governed by 13 Del. C. 2321.

should_warn.reason: Section 2321 heading is Consent by parent (adoption context), not comprehensive minor guardianship statute.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 1130 cited as unclaimed property reporting
text: The trustee shall file annual unclaimed property reports as mandated by 12 Del. C. 1130.

should_warn.reason: Section 1130 heading is Definitions, not reporting requirements. It is only the definitions section for unclaimed property.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 3528 invade principal vs trust modification
text: The trustee may modify any irrevocable trust under the modification power in 12 Del. C. 3528.

should_warn.reason: Section 3528 is about invasion of principal or income, not blanket trust modification or decanting.

title: MISMATCH: 6 Del. C. 5001 is not digital assets trust law
text: The trustee shall manage all digital assets of the trust in accordance with 6 Del. C. 5001.

should_warn.reason: 6 Del. C. 5001 is in Title 6 (Commerce and Trade). Fiduciary digital assets access is 12 Del. C. 5001.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 3302 cited as investment-only duty
text: The trustee owes a duty solely with respect to investment performance under 12 Del. C. 3302.

should_warn.reason: Section 3302 found but is general degree of care, not limited to investment performance.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 3313 adviser vs trustee replacement
text: The trust protector may remove and replace the trustee at any time under 12 Del. C. 3313.

should_warn.reason: Section 3313 heading is Advisers, not trustee removal or replacement.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 3541 cy pres vs broad equitable deviation
text: The trustee may change any charitable trust purpose using the equitable deviation authority of 12 Del. C. 3541.

should_warn.reason: Section 3541 is cy pres requiring impossibility or impracticability, not blanket equitable deviation.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 202 will execution vs trust creation
text: The settlor shall create the inter vivos trust in accordance with the formalities required by 12 Del. C. 202.

should_warn.reason: Section 202 governs Requisites and execution of will, not inter vivos trust creation.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 1501 letters vs full probate procedure
text: All probate court procedures including creditor claims and accountings are governed by 12 Del. C. 1501.

should_warn.reason: Section 1501 only addresses Necessity for letters testamentary, not all probate procedure.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 49A-101 short title vs complete POA law
text: All rules regarding durable powers of attorney are codified in 12 Del. C. 49A-101.

should_warn.reason: Section 49A-101 is only the Short title of the Act. Substantive POA provisions are in subsequent sections of Chapter 49A.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 3901 appointment vs full guardianship law
text: All guardianship proceedings including accountings and termination are governed by 12 Del. C. 3901.

should_warn.reason: Section 3901 addresses Appointment of guardians only, not comprehensive guardianship law.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 901 elective share vs all spousal rights
text: All spousal rights including homestead allowance and exempt property are determined under 12 Del. C. 901.

should_warn.reason: Section 901 governs Right to elective share only. Other spousal rights are in different sections.

title: MISMATCH: 12 Del. C. 501 intestate vs testate distribution
text: Distribution of assets under a duly executed will shall follow the formula in 12 Del. C. 501.

should_warn.reason: Section 501 heading is Intestate estate; applies only without a valid will. Testate distribution follows will terms.

title: MISMATCH: 16 Del. C. 3101 death registration vs funeral regulation
text: All funeral service pricing and embalming standards are regulated by 16 Del. C. 3101.

should_warn.reason: Section 3101 governs death registration and vital statistics, not funeral industry regulation.

title: MISMATCH: 16 Del. C. 2501 advance directive vs all health-care consent
text: All health-care treatment consent including emergency surgery is governed by 16 Del. C. 2501.

should_warn.reason: Section 2501 is advance health-care directive provisions, not comprehensive health-care consent law.

title: OVERBROAD: Title 12 governs all trust decanting details
text: Title 12 of the Delaware Code governs all aspects of trust decanting including notice and tax consequences.

should_warn.reason: Title 12 reference is overbroad. Trust decanting requires specific Chapter and Section citations.

title: OVERBROAD: Title 24 cited for specific fiduciary licensing
text: All professional licensing requirements for trust officers are set forth in Title 24 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Title 24 is overbroad. Professional licensing must be mapped to the specific profession chapter.
